tests.requirement: Exactly three method contracts share environment, task, budget, evaluator, PPO engine and PPO hyperparameters.
PPO actor advantages equal common-engine GAE and PPO performs no credit query.
Every credit estimate is finite and bound to the rollout batch and frozen policy version.
The completion-model version cannot change during current-iteration credit estimation.
Counterfactual evaluator deltas use only registered method-specific sources and do not exceed pre-reserved requested calls.
The actor uses validated credit while the critic digest remains bound to environment returns.
Pending labels commit only after a completed PPO update advances policy_version.
PPO, Policy-CC and MCC-PPO execute an identical task and identical PPO call path.
No-intervention and eta=0 configurations are equivalent to their declared parent paths.
Identity intervention yields zero paired return difference under matched replay.
No newly queried label affects same-iteration selection, control variate, fusion or actor update.
Concurrent requested, unique, backend, cache and source accounting is exact at budget exhaustion.
Checkpoint/resume preserves policy, optimizers, replay, pending labels, evaluator ledger, RNG and contract identities.
